IDIQ for Ventilation Ducting

PNS intends to solicit for the purchase of Ventilation Ducting for the Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, Kittery, ME. 

This requirement will be solicited as a 100% Small Business Set Aside (SBSA) procurement, and the size status for this requirement is 800 employees.

Additional details will be provided shortly.

Related Sources Sought Notice: https://sam.gov/opp/ae0286daec404147a10a727c7c99fcdc/view
